title: Positions index
description: data/positions-index.json -- the ids of every position exported to data/positions/, in Positions-sheet order. Exists only because Typst cannot list a directory: report code loops over this to display every position without naming them one by one (docs/domain/positions.md §7).

schema_version.description: -- pinned: an export written at another version is refused rather than read as this one.

archived.description: Additive (issue #9), written only where there is one: the positions deleted with their values kept («Copier les valeurs»), «S110-old» -- which a call may still name and no list of the project's positions shows (Woodcore-Datei/positions-archive.json).
